parsed.reason: Chinese, correct script, friendly tone. Facts covered: nothing shared until both agree, can switch off anytime, texts only if a good match comes up. But it adds "谢谢你" and "我会在有合适的家庭时再告诉你" which is fine; it omits that there is no search to report on (not strictly required to state). Main issue: "在那之前，什么都不会分享给别人" overstates slightly by implying nothing is shared at all, and "除非双方家庭都同意同一次介绍" is fine. Also "直接告诉我就行" is reasonable. Overall accurate but slightly stiff and not fully plain; no invented names or other-family hints.
